verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere's own SDK docs show it runs several model types on device: LLMs, vision-language models (image plus prompt), speech-to-text, text-to-speech, VAD, diarization and image generation. That covers the LLM and multi-modal parts of the story. Nothing in the pack supports the 'hundreds of architectures' breadth, and MoE and embedding models are never mentioned. missing for 10: evidence of support for hundreds of architectures, MoE model support, embedding model support, a supported-architecture list, independent corroboration of model breadth.
